Command.Name: graphics
Command.Title: Which Graphic Mod should you use?
Command.Description: Below you can find recommendations on graphic mods that are chosen based on stability & compatibility with LSPDFR.

Field.Name: __We recommend:__
Field.Value:
> [**CoreFX** (Free)](https://www.patreon.com/c/crxhvrd/home) 
 > A dramatic improvement on visual clarity / realism through advanced lighting, custom color grading, and sharper textures. 
 > [**Visual V** (Free)](https://www.gta5-mods.com/misc/visualv) 
 > A performance-friendly graphic overhaul that focuses on realism by rewriting weather cycles, improved rendering, and sharpening shadows. 
 > [**QuantV** (Paid)](https://www.patreon.com/c/QuantV/home) 
 > A premium, top-tier graphic overhaul featuring highly advanced custom shaders, real-time reflections, and physics-based lighting that delivers the absolute closest look to real-world footage.

Field.Name: __We don't recommend:__
Field.Value:
> [**Natural Vision Evolved** (Free/Paid)](https://www.razedmods.com/)
 > NVE looks great, but can cause crashes, performance problems and has compatibillity issues with LSPDFR. 
 > [**Redux** (Free)](https://gta5redux.com/)
 > GTA V Redux is no longer reliable on newer versions of GTAV. 
 > [**ENB** (Free)](http://enbdev.com/download.html)
 > ENB is missing crucial updates for latest GTA V versions and causes frequent crashes.
